author: GNiendorf
body:
Needed by (PR I will open soon in CMSSW) (mkFit fixes for the LST iteration). The two must be tested and merged together: the current release does not know the new cleaner used by the LST-step JSON, and the new code requires the new keys in every JSON.
 - All 16 iteration JSONs get the three keys of the new backward-fit outlier rejection: m_backward_fit_outlier_chi2, m_backward_fit_max_outliers, m_backward_fit_outlier_min_pt. They are 0 (off) everywhere except the Phase-2 HLT LST step (mkfit-phase2-lstStep.json: chi2 20, at most 3 outliers, tracks above 5 GeV).
 - mkfit-phase2-lstStep.json selects the new duplicate cleaner phase2:clean_duplicates_sharedhits_pixelpriority and sets dc_drth_central/obarrel/forward to0. This switches off the direction-only duplicate check, which removed real high-pT tracks in jets without looking at shared hits.
 - Every other iteration, including Run 3 and the Phase-2 offline LST step, behaves as before.

c.c. @slava77
title: Phase-2 HLT LST step: pixel-priority duplicate cleaner and other small improvements
